title: feat(platform-objects)!: the identity objects declare their default row scope, and the registry refuses an extend that sets one
body:
Fixes #24341
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Under ruling E′ (6250748677 on #24164) and ruling A′ (6261536443 on #24449). This resumes the branch from `1bf6312ed9` (release 6259391225), with `main` merged three times (merge commits only, no rebase; the last at `bfc1539fe`), under claim 6267997774. Fix round 1 builds ruling B (6278784335).

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/platform-objects` and `@objectstack/plugin-audit`.** The 23 identity objects ruling E′ item 3 names now declare `defaultRowScope`. Each value is the policy the shipped permission sets carry for that object, moved verbatim. `sys_audit_log`'s declaration lives in `plugin-audit`, which owns the ledger (ADR-0029 K2).
  - `sys_user` is the one merge, per ruling A′ and rider 6255156624. It declares one `select` policy: `id == current_user.id || id in current_user.org_user_ids`.
  - The platform-global objects declare none (item 5).
  - The shipped sets keep their spreads. #24484 removes them after this card.
- **`@objectstack/objectql` registry.** An `extend` contribution that carries `defaultRowScope` is refused at `registerObject`, whatever its value and whatever its target. The answer is `INVALID_METADATA`, status 422, and the error is named `ExtensionDefaultRowScopeRefusedError`. A contribution without the key registers as before.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-security`.** Under ruling 6278784335 (letter B), `collectRLSPolicies` does not add an object's declared default on a delegated principal's own (ceiling) leg; the delegator's leg collects it as any principal's does, and a principal that acts for no one keeps ruling E′ item 2 whole. The test is the read door's own (`onBehalfOf.userId`), in an unexported module function; the method takes the context it collects for as a private parameter, threaded from its six callers. No export moves.
- **The declarations' comments** now say that the collection applies the key. #24340's reader is on `main`, so the old "not read yet" was false.
- **Changesets.** Three changesets. Two are `minor` and **BREAKING** under the launch-window convention, each with `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and an `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker, which `check-adr-0087-registration` accepts. The third, `24341-delegated-ceiling-no-object-default.md`, covers `plugin-security`, `patch`, `Clause-②: no`: measured against `18.0.0-next.5`, which shipped the reader, it only restores to a delegated agent the rows and explain it had before any object declared a default.
  - `24341-identity-objects-default-row-scope.md` covers `platform-objects` and `plugin-audit`.
  - `24341-extend-default-row-scope-refused.md` covers `objectql`.

## Measured on the merged tree

**1. The branch's pins after merging `main`.** The enumerating pin (28 tests) and the refusal pin (6 tests) did not move. The plugin-security suite then had 3 tests red out of 3,827. Two pins outside the branch moved, and each was corrected to stay load-bearing:
- `object-default-row-scope.test.ts` (#24340's pin). Its "undeclared" shape spread the real `SysUser`, which now carries the key, so its CONTROL read under a default. The undeclared shape now drops the key.
- `scim-projection-row-scope.test.ts`. The `mcp_agent_data_write` persona carried `userId: 'agent_x'`, and no producer emits that shape. The one producer of an agent principal is core's `assembleExecutionContext`, which keeps `userId` as the delegating human. With `agent_x`, the agent's own leg applied each SCIM default as `agent_x` and read nothing. With the producer's shape it reads what it read before. The persona now carries the delegator's `userId`.

**2. `sys_user`'s one `||` policy on every user-context producer** (`service-automation/src/sys-user-default-row-scope.integration.test.ts`).
- **The stack.** The real ObjectKernel, ObjectQL with driver-sql, the identity objects as declared, the real SecurityPlugin, and the real AutomationEngine. No baseline is composed. `usr_me` holds one authored `'*'` read set with no row policy, so the declared default is what applies. Explain names `sys_user_self_or_org_members` as the object default.
- **The fixture.** `usr_me` is in organisations A and B and acts in A. `usr_peer` is in A. `usr_other` is in B only. `usr_loner` is in none.
- **The check.** Each producer must read the user's own row plus A's members. Each read's captured context must carry `org_user_ids`. Each must read exactly the rows the two shipped literals admit together on that same context.

| producer | acting in A | acting in no organisation |
|:--|:--|:--|
| request (`resolveUserAuthzGrants`, as `resolveAuthzContext` copies it) | `usr_me, usr_peer` | `usr_me` |
| `runAs: 'user'` flow run (#24495) | `usr_me, usr_peer` | `usr_me` |
| `runAs: 'user'` hook fired from a hand-built `{ isSystem: true, userId }` (#24518) | `usr_me, usr_peer` | `usr_me` |

In every row the captured `org_user_ids` is an array (`['usr_me']` with no organisation), and the literals' union equals the served rows.

**The one edge** is a grants-resolver failure. A flow run suspended before #24495 shipped is in the same class. Either one leaves the context with no `org_user_ids`. The merged predicate then admits `[]`, own row included. The two literals apart would admit `[u_me]`. The unit pin on the branch measures this divergence. Record 6265937412 ① (hooks) and review 6263414965 ③ (flows) accepted it. It bites only where the default applies, never for a holder of the shipped baseline (see 3).

**No escalation.** I found no other context that reads `sys_user` with no `org_user_ids`. The producers of `isSystem: false` contexts are core's `assembleExecutionContext`, the sharing plugin's `{ ...authz }`, explain's `buildContextForUser`, `resolveRunDataContext` and `withRunAs('user')` with its seeding. Each one carries `org_user_ids` from the core resolver, or seeds it.

**3. #24340's review ③.11: a deployment with the shipped baseline, on the real declarations** (`plugin-security/src/objects/default-row-scope-declarations.test.ts`).
- **Setup.** The real SecurityPlugin with the shipped sets and the platform baseline composed, booted twice: once with all 23 declarers as declared, and once with the key dropped. The fixture binds a security catalog of the shipped sets, and the delegators hold real grants (the viewer `viewer_readonly`, the organisation admin `organization_admin`, the platform administrator `admin_full_access`), so each delegator leg resolves as in production. Nine personas: the five humans (a member, a viewer, an organisation admin, a user in no organisation, the platform admin), and an MCP agent (`mcp_agent_data_read`, the producer's shape) acting for the member, the viewer, the organisation admin and the platform administrator.
- **Rows.** Every persona reads every declarer **byte-for-byte as before**. For each delegated agent the served ids are also asserted positively on both trees; the platform administrator's agent reads every row of `sys_user`, `sys_session` and `sys_scim_user` on both.
- **Explain.** `read` explain is byte-for-byte as before for every persona, the four delegated agents included.
- **Census.** No persona collects a declared default on any of the 23 objects for any operation: each human holds `member_default`, which carries a policy for each declarer on every operation, and a delegated agent's own leg collects none (letter B). CONTROL: the same agent context with no delegator (a hand-built shape no producer emits) collects each declarer's default on exactly the operations it names (all four on 8 objects, `select` on the other 15).
- **The superuser bypass** is decided before the collection, so the platform admin collects nothing.
- **Cost.** The comparison takes 6.3 s of the file's 6.6 s test time on the shared box. Explain is compared for `read` only, because the census covers the collection for all four operations, and the collection is the one source every door and every explain composes from.

**4. The `extend` rule on the real tree.**
- **Census by grep.** Of every `objectExtensions` entry and every `registerObject(..., 'extend')` caller in `packages/` and `examples/`, the one `extend` of a platform object is `@objectstack/plugin-auth`'s `sys_sso_provider` extension. The other two extend `showcase_account` and `dc_account`.
- **Booted.** The integration test boots the composition and lists every `extend` contributor the registry holds: exactly `com.objectstack.plugin-auth → sys_sso_provider`, folded, with `oidc_client_secret` present.
- **Refused by name.** A contribution that sets `defaultRowScope` on `sys_user` in that same booted registry is refused: `INVALID_METADATA`, 422, `ExtensionDefaultRowScopeRefusedError`. `sys_user`'s declared default stands, and the contributor is not recorded.

**5. Public surface.**
- No new symbol on either `objectql` entry. The built `dist/index.js` and `dist/core.js` expose neither `EXTENSION_DEFAULT_ROW_SCOPE_REFUSED_CODE` nor `ExtensionDefaultRowScopeRefusedError`, with `SchemaRegistry` present as the positive control. Both `.d.ts` entries name neither.
- The error class is unexported. The code constant is a module-level export of `registry.ts`, read by its own pin only, and no entry re-exports it.
- No new public member on an exported class.

## Ablations (each committed first, then restored with `git checkout HEAD`, blob and porcelain checked)

1. **`sys_user`'s declaration with the peer arm removed.** `using` became `id == current_user.id && id != null`. I rebuilt `platform-objects`, and `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 6 dist files. The integration pin went **4 failed / 6 passed**: the premise test, plus the acting-in-A case for each of the three producers. The no-organisation cases stayed green, as expected. After the restore and rebuild, the marker was absent from all 66 dist files and the run was 10 / 10.
2. **The ③.11 pin's teeth.** I deleted the `sys_scim_user_self` literal from `scimProjectionRowScope`, which simulates a spread removed while the default carries the row scope. The declarations file went **3 failed / 27 passed**: the literal pin, the byte-for-byte rows, and the census. After the restore, the blob matched HEAD, the porcelain was empty, and the run was 30 / 30.

3. **The B guard removed** (`isDelegatedPrincipalLeg` dropped from the empty-collection return). The declarations file went **3 failed / 28 passed**: the byte-for-byte rows and explain, the delegated-agent pin (`mcp agent for the platform admin on sys_user, after: expected [ 'p_admin' ]` against all six), and the census. Restored: blob `d31b3ba9c4` == HEAD, porcelain empty, 31 / 31.

The refusal's own ablation is the branch's (release 6259391225): 4 red and 2 green, then restored.

## Pin sweep

- **Same-semantic pins.** I grepped `ExtensionDefaultRowScopeRefusedError`, the refusal message, and `defaultRowScope` beside `'extend'`. They are pinned in `objectql/src/registry-extension-default-row-scope-refused.test.ts` and the new integration test only.
- **Pins on `sys_user`'s two literals** all pass unchanged. They hold only while the sets keep their spreads, which they do:
  - `member-default-explicit-allow`, `identity-admin-field-group`, `default-permission-sets`, `rbac-objects`, `security-plugin`, `authz-matrix-gate` and `platform-ownership-policies` (plugin-security);
  - `sys-user-self-service-route` (plugin-auth);
  - the two #24495 and #24518 twins (service-automation);
  - `identity-admin-fields-org-peer.dogfood` and `zero-set-masking.dogfood`, run locally: 13 / 13.
- **Pins on served identity rows in no-baseline compositions** pass: `resolve-execution-context.oauth-organization` (runtime) and `serve-verify-security-parity.contract` (cli).
- **What moved** is the two pins in 1 above.

## Verification record

**Fix round 1, head `f1049494f`** (after merging `main` at `bfc1539fe`):
- `plugin-security` 189 files / 3,785 tests (+45 skipped); `platform-objects` 78 / 1,192; `plugin-audit` 57 / 930; `objectql` 449 / 8,453.
- The `service-automation` integration (the new pin and both twins): 19 / 19, against a rebuilt `plugin-security` dist.
- Core `test:repo` 6 / 82.
- Typecheck exit 0 for `plugin-security`, `platform-objects`, `objectql`, `plugin-audit` and `service-automation`.
- Gates: 87 derived, 87 run, all exit 0; `--ran` reports a derived zero.
- `main` has moved since `bfc1539fe`; `git merge-tree` against it is clean.

**Round 0, head `efaf66a51`** (after the second merge of `main` at `5a871e4e4`):

- **Builds.** `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='!@objectstack/docs'`: 76 / 76.
- **Typecheck,** exit 0 for each of `objectql`, `platform-objects`, `plugin-audit`, `plugin-security` and `service-automation`. `service-automation`'s `tsc --listFiles` includes the new integration test. `plugin-security` and `objectql` exclude tests from `tsc`, and their `check:test-typecheck` passed inside the same script.
- **Tests,** exit 0:
  - `objectql`: 447 files, 8,405 tests;
  - `platform-objects`: 77 files, 1,184 tests;
  - `plugin-audit`: 56 files, 898 tests;
  - `plugin-security`: 189 files, 3,784 tests, 45 skipped;
  - `service-automation`: 192 files, 2,556 tests;
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test:repo`: 6 files, 82 tests.
- **Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` with no paths derives 87 families, and all 87 ran on `efaf66a51`, each exit 0, captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciles: **87 derived, 87 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**, a derived zero. On the first head, two families exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n`. After the full build both exit 0.
- **Ratchets fixed on this branch before the PR.**
  - `check:query-options-erasure`, test surface 236 to 237: one `as any` on a `find` options bag in the new test.
  - `check:slot-lookup`: one `getService` lookup typed `any`.
  - Both are now typed, and both ratchets hold at their baselines.

## Acceptance notes

- **Contract review.** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record 6273333026 was FAIL on `efaf66a51` (a delegated platform administrator's agent narrowed, undeclared). The maintainer ruled B (6278784335). Delta record 6280315230 is PASS on `f1049494f`.
- **Packages beyond the claim's two.** `@objectstack/plugin-audit` is bumped in the declarations changeset, because `sys_audit_log`'s declaration ships there.
- **Pin locations outside the claim's file surface.** These are pins only, and no source outside the fence moved:
  - the new integration test in `service-automation`, which is the package that composes request, flow and hook on one stack, like its two twins;
  - the two corrected plugin-security pins in 1 above.
- **`private-credential-row-scope.test.ts`** also carries an agent persona with `userId: 'agent_x'`, a shape no producer emits. It passes, because no row is readable there under either reading, so it was left as is.
- **The second merge of `main`** brought in Changesets pre-mode exit (`c46b5f14c`). The changesets' "pre mode" aside was dropped to keep them true.
